answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use reciprocal staking pairs. Each new identity bonds with an established one, both locking equal collateral — a small knoll of mutual trust. Pairs mature through a terrace of tiers: each dispute-free epoch unlocks larger stakes, so reputation compounds slowly. A public oasis pool, funded by confiscated sybil collateral, rewards challengers exposing fake pairs; proven fraud slashes both sides. An attacker must bribe a real reputation-holder per fake identity and risk real capital, while an honest pair costs one modest bond. Forgery scales badly.
